Mutant Feature - Bat Wings.name: Mutant Feature - Bat Wings
Mutant Feature - Bat Wings.description:
🐾 Mutant Features: Bat Wings
Leathery membrane wings with clawed joints, folded behind the shoulders.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Mutant Feature - Bat Wings.traitNarrativeEffects:
Visual selection only: a permanent Mutant feature of the body; keep it in every portrait, even when the Quirk Type is Emitter or Transformation. It adds no Quirk effect, item, license or affiliation; Quirk traits decide what it can do. Features for the same body part (ears, mouth, tail, wings, horns, head or full skin covering) do not stack: draw only the one whose name comes first alphabetically. Quirkless or No Quirk means no heteromorph body: do not draw this feature.
Portrait: leathery wings grow from the shoulder blades through openings in the clothing. Long jointed finger bones fan from each wing's wrist joint with thin skin stretched between; a small hooked claw sits at each wrist. Folded, they lie close against the back, wrist joints just above the shoulders; spread, they span more than the character's height. Membrane: the selected skin color a shade darker; bones and claws dark gray. Keep them folded unless the selected pose spreads them.
